title: Shiraishi An — Happy Birthday! 2026〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Days before An's birthday
Street SEKAI

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Phew! Another great practice today.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You were on fire today, An.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I thought you were gonna tire yourself out, but you kept it up the whole session.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hahaha. For some reason, I felt like I was more into it than usual!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I am a little tired now, though. Can we swing by MEIKO's?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, that sounds great.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hmm, what should I get today? What am I in the mood for?
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hi, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I feel like we should do something special for the occasion, you know!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah. If we're gonna do anything, we should do it big!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, hello there.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Everyone seems pretty hyped up. Whatcha planning? Some kind of event?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Something like that, I guess? We're talking about what to do for your birthday.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh? My birthday?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It's coming up, isn't it? We were talking about how to celebrate.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: We're still deciding what to do...but we want it to be special!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Aww, I see. Thanks, guys!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Were you out practicing with them, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah. It was a good session today. Everyone's been in great shape since coming to the US.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Maybe it's the atmosphere. With everything we've seen and heard here, it's like we can't just sit around, you know?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And when practice goes this well, it just makes me wanna sing on stage, which is a bit of a problem.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: On stage?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! You know, I just wanna belt it out on stage!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We haven't really performed at all since we got to the United States.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Maybe we should look for an event we can join right when we get back to Japan.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: An event...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Ah!!!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Whoa! You scared me...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Why'd you shout all of a sudden, Rin?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Ah, sorry, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But I just had an idea! A great idea for An's birthday!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: A great idea?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehehe. You just look forward to it! It's gonna be awesome, I promise!
An's birthday
Plaza

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Ta-dah! Welcome to your birthday party venue!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wow! It's set up like a music fest! That's awesome!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Look at all the balloons, too. Red, yellow, blue... The plaza looks more lively than ever.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I didn't expect you to deck the whole plaza out for her birthday. You really went all out, huh?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Anything worth doing is worth doing big!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Also, look, look! We all put that stage together!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I saw it as soon as I came over! Just look at the size of that thing!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That explains why you wouldn't let any of us into the plaza... You were putting this all together.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: If you could all take your seats, please. I've prepared plenty of food for you all.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wow, look at all this! Did you make all this, MEIKO?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That's right. Miku and the others helped, too.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Look at all the different kinds of sandwiches. The pizza and pasta with meat sauce look so good too.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I put together a spread of things An's enjoyed before.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wow, thanks so much! Everything looks so good... Where do I even start?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe, I'm glad to hear it. Go ahead and eat your fill.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, but we have a cake too, so be sure to leave a little room for that.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Woohoo! I've been looking forward to your cake!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Alright, everyone, let's get this party started.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Do you all have your party poppers? Here we go...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Happy birthday, An!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line:
Happy birthday!
Happy birthday.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Thanks, everyone! Let's have a great day today!
One hour later

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Mmm! This is so good!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Isn't it just? This is MEIKO's special rum raisin birthday cake, you know!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And why are you being smug about that?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe, it really is delicious. I don't think I've ever had a cake with rum raisin mousse before.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: This is probably the best way to have rum raisin ever! MEIKO, you're a genius!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh? My phone...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Ah... I'm getting tons of messages!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Are those birthday wishes?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! From classmates and old friends... And everyone from Vivid Street, too.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. Look at them all... I'm so happy!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You know pretty much everyone, Shiraishi, so it's no surprise you're getting so many messages.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That's really great, An.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Ahem! Attention please!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Now that the party's in full swing, it's time for our special celebrations! Is everyone ready?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh? Did you all prepare something?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, Rin told us to come up with something.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, okay!
Wait, Kohane, you too...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe, of course I did.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: First up is Kohane, Luka and Len! They have a special birthday show for you!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh?! A show?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I worked on it in secret, with Emu as my advisor.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm not used to putting on shows myself, but we'll do our best to make sure you have fun!
se_walk_women_001_1
se_walk_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay... Here we go!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: “Once upon a time, there lived a princess with a magical singing voice...”
